name: Ginger-Bathhouse Haven
core_rationale: Central geothermal bathhouse sanctuary town of Ginger-Steam Terraces at [1, 1] where Lantern-Keepers steep herbal ginger-tea baths above the Teapot Steam Cistern.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Stepped golden-ochre travertine soaking pools fed by whistling ceramic teapot spouts

North.lock_message: Dense aromatic steam clouds across Cardamom-Cloud Overlook obscure the upper travertine ledges; Bathhouse-Matron Yuzu requires the Porcelain Whistle Valve before opening the northern gate.

resident_npcs.name: Bathhouse-Matron Yuzu
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Ginger-Bathhouse Haven! Step up to my 0.58 meter towel-and-tea counter—our travertine pools warm every traveler before the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct.

resident_npcs.name: Kettle-Plumber Kabocha
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Teapot Steam Cistern, an over-pressurized boiler golem holds the Porcelain Whistle Valve needed for Cardamom-Cloud Overlook!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Ginger-Steam Terraces at [1, 1] directly above Sola's Teapot Steam Cistern and connects west to Ginger Aqueduct Bridge.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Glazed teapot-domed bathhouses and golden travertine soaking pools veiled in warm ginger mist.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m tea counters, 0.14m travertine risers, 2.10m x 1.55m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Cardamom-Cloud Overlook behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
